notes: Ban 1.5.1: Ho tro Revit 2027 (bo cai chung cho Revit 2024-2027; tren 2027 add-in nam o C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\2027). Auto Tag nang cap: quet toan view 1 click, 1 tag cho moi doan ong cung cao do, tag khong de len nhau, tu can hang, tuy chon Leader nhu tag native. Them tool Pipe from CAD (panel Plumbing): ve ong thoat nuoc co do doc tu DWG/DXF. Duct from CAD: he thong theo tien to nhan, pick layer tren CAD, fitting Reducer/Tee, preview, sua loi ong noi xuyen khoang trong. Ra soat toan bo tool, sua 7 nhom loi. Dong Revit truoc khi cai.
